UnprotectedBehavior.Description: Writer A commits seq 1 (ineligible), pauses before publication. Writer B commits seq 2 (eligible) and publishes. Writer A resumes and publishes.
UnprotectedBehavior.Finding: Without monotonic sequence validation, an earlier transaction that commits first but publishes late permanently overwrites newer memory state with stale data.

PatchedBehavior.Description: Writer A commits seq 3, pauses. Writer B commits seq 4 and publishes. Writer A resumes and attempts publication at seq 3.
PatchedBehavior.Mechanism: PublishCrossPlane rejects seq 3 because seq 4 is already published for Account 1. Older event is safely dropped with zero lock contention.

CrashRecoveryFailClosed.Policy: If an exception occurs after PostgreSQL commit but before publication completes, the coordinator marks IsHealthy = false.
CrashRecoveryFailClosed.SafetyGuarantee: All subsequent queries fail closed with InvalidOperationException until ReconcilePendingMutationsAsync catches up and restores health.
